name: Tusked
source:
Play as Che, an elephant with a never ending need for tail. Come home and handle the Yakuza heir Itazura for breaking your window.

[From [url=https://itazura3d.itch.io/tusked]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演切——一头欲壑难填、终日寻欢的大象。回到家中，好好教训那个砸破你家窗户的极道少主伊塔祖拉吧。

[摘自[url=https://itazura3d.itch.io/tusked]itch.io[/url]]
